artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from minor fidelity issues typical of AI generation or heavy compression. The branding text is illegible (gibberish), and the translucent water tank has soft, ill-defined boundaries (supported by lower SAM mask confidence). These are noticeable but do not detract significantly from the overall recognition of the object. The base formula suggested 2.55, but this seems too harsh for what are essentially minor texture/rendering flaws rather than structural deformations. A score of 3.85 reflects 'good quality with minor imperfections'.
